Re: Account reference: ACC-528361

We acknowledge receipt of your dispute regarding the account referenced above. You have disputed the debt as "not mine." We understand that you believe the debt is not yours, and we will investigate this matter further.

Pursuant to the Fair Debt Collection Practices Act (FDCPA), 15 U.S.C. § 1692g, we are required to provide you with a written validation notice within five days of the initial communication. However, you have not requested a validation notice, and we will not provide one at this time.

We will investigate your dispute and verify the ownership of the debt. We will also review the account history to ensure that the debt was properly charged off on December 18, 2023, and that the last payment was made on July 18, 2025. The current balance on the account is $1,718.30.

Please note that our investigation may take some time to complete. We will notify you of our findings and any further action we may take. If our investigation confirms that the debt is indeed yours, we will continue to attempt to collect the debt. However, if our investigation confirms that the debt is not yours, we will take steps to remove the debt from your credit report and cease collection efforts.

You have the right to further dispute this debt if you believe our investigation was not thorough or if you have additional information to provide. Please contact us at your earliest convenience if you have any further questions or concerns.

Sincerely,

Bridgeport Recovery Inc.
